items.title: Dave Rivello interviewed by Monk Rowe, Rochester, New York, January 11, 2012
items.q: I think you have to be a Chick Corea or somebody — maybe he has to pay.

ctx.x: Well occasionally there are the periods where you have to buy the room and you invite the critics or you invite the audience or you do the ticket sales. So — the Blue Note I don’t know. I think you have to be a Chick Corea or somebody — maybe he has to pay. But there’s plenty of other places that people are paying attention to. So we’ll see what happens with that, but that’s definitely on the front burner.
Anything you want to add yourself here?
